description: Deepen the geology-based signal that drove exp009's 1.81 RMSE win. Add multi-row geology context windows around the aligned TVT point, global layer index (counted from top of typewell stack), normalized layer position within the typewell, and geology-conditional GR residual (lateral GR minus mean GR of that geology layer in the typewell). Keep all exp009 features; only ADD.
implementation_notes: Reuse exp009 feature pipeline from src/features.py. Add new functions; do not modify existing ones.
Layer index = 1-based index of the contiguous geology run within the typewell, counted from the top (smallest TVT). 'From bottom' is the symmetric count.
tw_geology_layer_mean_gr / std_gr: per-typewell aggregates of GR conditioned on geology label. Compute once per typewell and look up.
gr_minus_layer_mean_gr: lateral GR at current row minus the typewell mean GR of the aligned geology layer — captures local deviation that may indicate misalignment.
Use LightGBM with same params as exp009. Categorical features: pass geology label columns native to LightGBM via categorical_feature.
5-fold GroupKFold by well_id. Target to beat: exp009 (34.581).
